name: M-40 "Thunderbolt"
description: The M-40 "Thunderbolt" was a model of light repeating blaster. Produced by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc., the blaster rifle could fire a long-ranged distance. As a light repeating blaster, the weapon had a high rate of fire fed from a power magazine or a backpack-mounted power generator, was over two meters long, and also possessed a stun setting. Often carried by a support gunner with the required tools and training, legal purchase of such blasters was restricted to the Imperial Army, planetary defense forces, and private military contractors.
